  FR-2 [MVP] Requesting an existing short code redirects the client to the original long URL associated with that short code.
  FR-3 [MVP] The redirect response uses HTTP status 302 (temporary redirect).
  FR-4 [MVP] A client can retrieve the details of an existing short link by its short code.
  FR-5 [MVP] The service keeps a total click count for each short link, incremented by one on each successful redirect.
  FR-6 [MVP] The service records the timestamp of the most recent click (successful redirect) for each short link.
  FR-7 [MVP] A client can retrieve a short link's analytics, consisting of the total click count and the last-click timestamp, through a separate per-link API call.
  FR-8 [MVP] Short codes are always generated by the service; clients cannot supply a custom alias.
  FR-9 [MVP] Each create submission produces a new, independent short link with its own short code and click count, even when the same long URL was submitted before.
  FR-10 [MVP] Only absolute http or https URLs are accepted when creating a short link; any other value is rejected with a client error (4xx) response and no short link is created.
  FR-11 [MVP] A short link's details include the short code, the original long URL and the creation timestamp.
  FR-12 [MVP] The redirect, details and analytics calls return 404 Not Found for a short code that does not exist.
  FR-13 [MVP] For a short link that has never been clicked, analytics report a click count of 0 and a null or absent last-click timestamp.
  FR-14 [MVP] Every successful redirect counts as exactly one click, including repeat clicks from the same client, with no de-duplication or bot filtering.
  FR-15 [MVP] All operations (create, redirect, details, analytics) can be called without authentication.

  A-2 Submitting the same long URL more than once creates a new, independent short link each time (Q-2 default).
  A-3 Only absolute http/https URLs are accepted on create; anything else is rejected with a client error (Q-3 default).
  A-4 Details include the short code, the original URL and the creation timestamp; analytics (total clicks and last-click timestamp) are returned by a separate per-link call (Q-4 default).
  A-5 Redirect, details and analytics calls return 404 Not Found for unknown short codes (Q-5 default).
  A-6 A never-clicked link reports a click count of 0 and a null/absent last-click timestamp (Q-6 default).
  A-7 Every successful redirect counts as one click, with no de-duplication or bot filtering (Q-7 default).
  A-8 No authentication is required; all operations are public (Q-8 default).
  A-9 Per C-1, 'reliability features' maps to no catalog entry, so no non-functional requirement is included until the user selects one or more catalog entries.

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: URL Shortener Service with Click Analytics
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Create short links, redirect by short code (302) and read per-link details and click analytics. All operations are public (no authentication).
paths:
  /api/links:
    post:
      operationId: createShortLink
      summary: Create a new short link for an absolute http/https URL (FR-1, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-15)
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateLinkRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Short link created. A new independent link is created on every call.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: Path of the created link's details resource (/api/links/{code}).
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShortLink'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '415':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /api/links/{code}:
    get:
      operationId: getShortLink
      summary: Get a short link's details (FR-4, FR-11, FR-12, FR-15)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ShortCode'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Short link details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShortLink'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /api/links/{code}/analytics:
    get:
      operationId: getShortLinkAnalytics
      summary: Get a short link's click analytics (FR-7, FR-12, FR-13, FR-15)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ShortCode'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Click analytics for the link
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkAnalytics'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /{code}:
    get:
      operationId: redirectToLongUrl
      summary: Redirect to the original URL and count the click (FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-12, FR-14, FR-15)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ShortCode'
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Temporary redirect to the original long URL. The click is counted.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: The original long URL associated with the short code.
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
            Cache-Control:
              description: Always no-store, so every click reaches the service.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: no-store
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
components:
  parameters:
    ShortCode:
      name: code
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Service-generated short code
      schema:
        type: string
        example: aB3xK9q
  schemas:
    CreateLinkRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - url
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
          description: Absolute URL with scheme http or https
          example: https://example.com/some/long/path
    ShortLink:
      type: object
      required:
        - shortCode
        - longUrl
        - createdAt
      properties:
        shortCode:
          type: string
          example: aB3xK9q
        longUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: https://example.com/some/long/path
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    LinkAnalytics:
      type: object
      required:
        - shortCode
        - clickCount
      properties:
        shortCode:
          type: string
          example: aB3xK9q
        clickCount:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        lastClickedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: Timestamp of the most recent successful redirect; null if never clicked
    Problem:
      type: object
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          example: about:blank
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Invalid request (missing/malformed body or URL that is not absolute http/https). No short link is created.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    NotFound:
      description: No short link exists for the given short code
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    UnsupportedMediaType:
      description: Request body Content-Type is not application/json
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    InternalError:
      description: Unexpected server error
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'

</openapi>
